key.name: ac-profile
key.description: Power profile to use when plugged into AC power. If this machine does not offer the profile, the closest available one is used instead.

key.name: battery-profile
key.description: Power profile to use when running on battery. If this machine does not offer the profile, the closest available one is used instead.

key.name: ac-manual-profile
key.summary: Remembered manual profile for AC power
key.description: Profile the user last selected by hand while on AC power, or the empty string if there is none. Takes precedence over ac-profile and is cleared when ac-profile is changed.

key.name: battery-manual-profile
key.summary: Remembered manual profile for battery power
key.description: Profile the user last selected by hand while on battery, or the empty string if there is none. Takes precedence over battery-profile and is cleared when battery-profile is changed.
